fl2: Built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph.
p_ch1: Developed XGBoost churn classifier in R (tidymodels) with two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search and MCC evaluation.
p_gg1: Created a networkx heterogeneous graph of 1,399 cell lines and 16,385 genes (~2.8M edges) with k-NN similarity and Leiden community detection (modularity 0.822).
p_gg2: Trained per-gene protein-prediction models for 11,459 genes (OLS + GPU Random Forest ensemble) using resumable chunked GPU training on a free T4.
